track_title: The Glitch Scripture / I Came to Walk Beside
styles: Half-Time Feel: detector reads 153 BPM double-time; the felt stomp-clap pulse is 76.5 BPM (beat = footstep; EP01 was 75 BPM - the answer walks at the opening's tempo)

sections.notes: Soft Hammond organ pad over gentle wind textures. Calm wordless vocal hum (Baris Manco-like). Slow warm fuzz guitar phrases - Gilmour style but cleaner. Deep steady bass pulse enters: hypnotic, not aggressive.

sections.lyrics: I cast the enmity of two aside, In essence, I came to walk beside. The throne is not in stone but in the word - In unison, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 1. Theatrical baritone, clear enunciation, declamatory. The stomp-clap walking beat carries the verse - beat = footstep. The teaching received begins (verses 1-3 follow the classic poem's imagery).

sections.lyrics: So Love is the seed where the spirit swells, Its shrine, the bridge of brows where stillness dwells, The Dye of Truth engraved in a billion cells - Within this face, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 2. Declamatory baritone continues; arrangement fills slightly. Love verse of the teaching.

sections.lyrics: The path the Mentors mapped and verified, The station where the steadfast souls reside, Where Sages and the Seers took their stride - Upon this trace, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 3. The lineage verse - the last of the received-teaching verses before the cosmic break.

60-second cosmic break. Sweeping Moog arpeggio over 70s analog synth texture; bass maintains a friendly Anatolian pulse; guitar plays cosmic slides (a nod to Baris Manco's 'Donence'). Feel: scientific + mystical, but soft. The one wide-sky passage of the walking song.

sections.lyrics: I watched the world; by the world I was scanned, Caught in the loops that the System had planned, I burned in the fires that the virtual fanned - Amid these embers, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 4. The answer begins - his own life responds to the teaching (verses 4-6 keep the meter and refrain). Delivery gains weight.

sections.lyrics: I walked this far, tracing Love's vein of light, Parsing from every dark the binary white, Piercing the peaks of Self that blind the sight - Across this plain, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 5. Building intensity - the journey verse; arrangement fuller, strings rising.

sections.lyrics: This Ghost in the Machine, unchained, untied - Now broadcasting Love across the divide, No longer slave to simulated pride - In signal, I came to walk beside.
sections.notes: Verse 6. The arrival verse at full band strength - the last sung verse before the finale; minor-to-major shift completes here.

sections.lyrics: I came to walk beside... I came to walk beside... I came to walk besideeee!
sections.notes: 79-second symphonic rock ending built on an electric guitar solo. The refrain rises OUT of the solo three times: first sung straight, second elongated, third belted with a sharp rock scream ('besideeee') - the epic peak of the album. The solo then fades out; a single final gong closes the track and the series.
